# Official Agent Plugins 1.0.0 schema snapshots

Downloaded without modification on 2026-09-19 from:

- https://agent-plugins.org/schemas/1.0.0/plugin.schema.json
- https://agent-plugins.org/schemas/1.0.0/mcp.schema.json

These snapshots make portable-manifest checks reproducible without fetching
schemas during tests. They validate document shape; host installation and public
listing acceptance are separate operational checks. The release report records
the snapshot digests. The official sources retain ownership of these schemas.
